## Documentation

# Onboard to Marketplace

Use this skill to move a ready SaaS platform into a publishable Azure Marketplace offer.

## What this skill covers

1. Publisher and Partner Center readiness checks.
2. Offer setup (listing, plans, pricing, legal).
3. Technical validation inputs (fulfillment, landing page, webhooks).
4. Private audience testing and certification prep.
5. Final launch checklist and operational handoff.

## Output

- Marketplace onboarding checklist with blockers.
- Required artifact inventory for submission.
- Go-live readiness status by stage.
